pokedexEntries.ru: SWAMPERT is very strong. It has enough power to easily drag a boulder weighing more than a ton. This POKéMON also has powerful vision that lets it see even in murky water.

pokedexEntries.sa: SWAMPERT predicts storms by sensing subtle differences in the sounds of waves and tidal winds with its fins. If a storm is approaching, it piles up boulders to protect itself.

pokedexEntries.frlg: Its arms are rock-hard. With one swing, they can batter down its foe. It makes its nest on beautiful beaches.

pokedexEntries.em: If it senses the approach of a storm and a tidal wave, it protects its seaside nest by piling up boulders. It swims as fast as a jet ski.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.

pokedexEntries.hgss: Its arms are hard as rock. With one swing, it can break a boulder into pieces.
